dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGW07 is part of the ORCA system developed by Japan Medical Association and NACL.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt billing system - system management information settings module (W07). Handles automatic calculation check settings, outpatient management fee checks, time-outside surcharge settings, hospitalization initial diagnosis fee, prescription information provision fee, and various other clinical billing configuration parameters.
purpose.summary: ORCGW07 is a configuration/settings screen program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It manages system management information settings including automatic calculation checks, outpatient management surcharges, time-outside surcharge exceptions, hospitalization settings, and numerous other billing control flags. It is a large batch/online screen program with extensive COPY statements and PERFORM-driven logic.

notable_features: 74 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
755 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses GnuCOBOL file I/O or middleware)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments throughout (decoded as latin-1)
Extensive SPA (scratchpad area) working storage layout
Long revision history with version tracking in comments
verdict.notes: File is 476KB / 10208 lines - a large production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but the file was decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source was truncated to first 16000 chars but structural indicators confirm full COBOL program with all four divisions.
